letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai feels brighter because I get to share it with you, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to have a cutie like you by my side. Since that magical day on 23 Feb 2025, you’ve turned ordinary moments into golden memories. I love how we blend spices and skyscrapers, laughter and lullabies, creating a love that’s as endless as the desert dunes and as sweet as mangoes in summer. Forever yours, Tirth.
poem:
In desert sands and rainy streets we roam,  
Your smile is my compass, always home.  
Together we dance through heat and rain,  
My heart beats, “Liza, love you again.”
